mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and lower corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances following two consecutive quarters of GDPC1 decline.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of instances where INDPRO rises > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market with wage pressures, leading to higher inflation expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to reduced economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of instances where HOUST drops > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressures in a tightening monetary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances following two consecutive months of RSAFS increase.
